messages:
sam: quick alert: we're seeing intermittent OOMs in eu-west multi-tenant when users send very long multimodal prompts. Patch ready: image + tokenizer guard (2.3.9-hotfix). No client or schema changes. Requesting a short maintenance window tonight 00:30-01:00 UTC. Plan: smoke -> 3% canary -> 100% (10m ramp) if metrics stay green. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.3% over 1m OR container memory > 78% for 2m.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued from @sam
- image: `redwood/serving:2.3.9-hotfix`
- targets: eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool
- strategy: staged canary (3% -> 100%)
- smoke: `smoke/multi-tenant-longprompt` (1k token run)
- rollback-probe: `5xx_rate>0.3||mem_pct>78`

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @nora (priority)  please ack to avoid auto-escalation.

nora: acked. I'll watch the window and can trigger rollback if probe trips.

claire: can +1 expedited approval if rollback is automated and dedicated pools are pinned.

sam: dedicated pools will remain pinned to 2.3.8. Only multi-tenant pool gets canary. Added webhook rollback + runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/multitenant-oom

albert: include the dedicated-pin command in the PR so support can re-pin if needed.

claire: :+1: approve expedited roll.

sam: release note draft: "2.3.9-hotfix: prevent serializer OOM on long multimodal prompts in eu-west multi-tenant pool. No client changes." attaching to PR now.

deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window -> start 1851112250 (canary 3%). CLI preview:

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.3.9-hotfix \
  --targets eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 3 --canary-duration 10m \
  --smoke smoke/multi-tenant-longprompt --rollback-probe "5xx>0.3||mem>78"
```

sam: kicking smoke now, will post results in ~90s.

(90s later)
sam: smoke clean. no errors, mem stable. starting 3% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 3% at 1851112310. Observability hooks live.

nora: monitoring traces and node mem. nothing alarming so far.

(8m later)
sam: ramping to 100% now per fast-approve. will watch for 15m before closing the window.

deploy-bot: Ramp complete: 100% at 1851112380.

nora: post-ramp checks look good: 5xx at baseline, mem usage healthy. No rollback needed.

albert: thanks all. added dedicated-pin command to PR and left post-deploy note for support.

sam: closing window in 15m and will add final post-deploy summary to release PR :rocket:
